description: Permanent audit row for one generation pass of a Tally Migration Session. Item 8.5 Stage 3. Session-level artefact fields (session.generated_je_draft etc.) mirror the MOST RECENT pass's Draft/Submitted JE; this child table is the permanent per-pass record.

fields.description: 1-based pass counter. Pass 1 is the first generate_all run; Pass 2+ are delta generations from Partial Submitted state.
fields.label: Pass Number

fields.description: Draft after generate; Submitted after mark_submitted verifies JE docstatus=1; Failed if atomic generate_all rolled back mid-sequence.
fields.label: Pass Status

fields.description: Draft (Pass active) or Submitted (Pass locked). Pass 1 Main JE's docname; Pass 2 uses the P2-suffixed reference_id.
fields.label: Main JE

fields.description: Artefact reference ID per RGI rules sec 6.2. Pass 1: OB-{ABBR}-{FY}-01. Pass N (N>=2): OB-{ABBR}-{FY}-01-P{N}.
fields.label: Main JE Reference

fields.description: Count of Mapping Decisions stamped generated_in_pass = this pass_number (account-side + supplier-side, excludes students bypass).
fields.label: Decisions Included

fields.description: Count of Mapping Decisions with review_action=Deferred at the moment this pass generated. Carries forward to Pass N+1.
fields.label: Decisions Deferred (post-pass)

fields.description: Student ledger count written to this pass's Students CSV. Students bypass the mapper (parser-flagged is_student_ledger), tracked separately from decisions_included_count.
fields.label: Student Decisions

fields.description: Signed Temporary Opening contribution for this pass (Main JE balancer + Advance JE balancer). Cumulative sum across passes should net to zero after the final pass in ERPNext GL.
fields.label: Temp Opening Contribution (signed)

fields.description: Per-generator log lines captured during this pass's generate_all. Preserved across re-runs; audit trail.
fields.label: Generator Log

name: Migration Pass
